According to unverified rumors, only 20 of these upgraded pistols were ever made by an unnamed turncoat corpo engineer. Three were ordered by Mr. Hands, seven for EBM Petrochem Stadium clients, nine for BARGHEST, and one to an unknown recipient.

Category: Very Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 20 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Pistol Long Barrel, Tech Rebuild, Zetatech Experimental Scope (+1 to Aimed Shots) • Mods: None

Special Features: When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 2 rounds in a burst. If there are not 2 rounds left in the magazine, Single Shot expends the entire magazine. When this weapon inflicts a Head Critical Injury on a meat person, the victim also suffers the effect (but not the Bonus Damage) of the Damaged Eyes Critical Injury in addition to whatever other Critical Injury is rolled by the user. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6).

Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Long Barrel, Tech Rebuild, Zetatech Experimental Scope (+1 to Aimed Shots) (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
